source: Anthropic first-party API list prices, captured 2026-08-15.
disclaimer: These are list rates for ESTIMATES ONLY. They are not your invoice: subscription plans (Max/Pro) do not bill per token at all, and negotiated or partner rates (Bedrock, Vertex) differ. arc-usage labels every dollar figure as an estimate for this reason. Re-check against https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/pricing when a model ships or a promo ends.

multipliers.note: Cache reads cost ~0.1x base input. Writes cost 1.25x at the 5-minute TTL and 2x at the 1-hour TTL. Break-even is 2 requests on a 5m entry and 3 on a 1h entry — cache CREATION is the expensive line, which is why arc-usage calls it out separately.

promo.note: Introductory pricing, in effect through 2026-08-31. Standard rates are 3.00 input / 15.00 output; update this entry when the promo ends.

unpriced.note: Models absent from this table (including the synthetic entries Claude Code writes for local, non-API turns) are counted in token totals but contribute 0 to cost, and arc-usage names them so a silent gap is visible rather than assumed to be free.
